intro: This zone is the older core of West Ahmedabad, just across the Sabarmati from the walled city, and takes in Navrangpura, Ellisbridge, Paldi, Ambawadi and Vasna. Navrangpura mixes residential societies with busy commercial streets and the crossroads around Vijay Cross Roads. Ellisbridge, named after the bridge rebuilt in steel in 1892, sits near the riverfront, Law Garden and the office stretch along Ashram Road. Paldi has traditional lanes of independent houses, some from the Art Deco period, beside apartment complexes and builder floors. Ambawadi, including the Sukhipura pocket, is mostly apartments with quieter villa lanes, and Vasna is largely multi-storey societies along its ring road.

For a family choosing a tutor, the zone is unusually well connected. Old High Court is the one station where the Blue Line and Red Line meet, and the Red Line then runs south with stops in Ellisbridge, Paldi and Ambawadi before ending at APMC in Vasna, with Jivraj Park and Rajiv Nagar just before it. Commerce Six Road and a second Blue Line stop serve Navrangpura. That means a tutor living in the northern suburbs, on the east bank or near Thaltej can often ride in and walk the last stretch. The limits are older lanes with little parking and the bridge approaches at office time.

NXTutors matches a family in this zone by starting with tutors who live here, then adding tutors who travel in on the Red or Blue Line, then others across Ahmedabad, and finally online tutors from anywhere in India. You see two or three profiles, each showing the tutor's own fee before the demo is booked. The first class is a free demo, and you decide after it. Families in Paldi and Ambawadi who want a specialist for board or entrance subjects often mix a weekly home lesson with online sessions. Switching to a different tutor later on is free.
faqs: Which localities make up the Navrangpura, Paldi & Ellisbridge zone?

Navrangpura, Ellisbridge, Paldi, Ambawadi and Vasna, on the west bank of the Sabarmati facing the old city. Navrangpura was one of the first areas to develop outside the walled city, and the zone mixes older independent houses and low-rise blocks with newer apartment towers and busy commercial streets.
Can a tutor from Sabarmati or Naranpura reach Paldi by metro?

Yes, directly. The Red Line runs south from Motera Stadium through Sabarmati and Vijay Nagar to Old High Court, then on through Ellisbridge and Paldi to Ambawadi and Vasna. A tutor on that line can ride straight to the station nearest your home and finish the trip on foot or by auto.
Where does the Red Line end in Vasna?

At APMC station, the southern terminus, with Jivraj Park and Rajiv Nagar as the next stations north. City buses also serve Vasna. Most homes here are apartment societies where the guard notes visitors, and a two-wheeler is usually easier to park than a car, so many tutors ride in.
Is the demo class really free?

Yes. After you receive two or three matched tutors and see each one's fee, the first class with the tutor you choose costs nothing, whether at home or online. You decide only after that lesson, and if you later want someone else, NXTutors lines up another tutor and switching is free.

intro: The SG Highway corridor zone covers Satellite, Jodhpur, Vastrapur, Bodakdev, Thaltej and Memnagar. Satellite is a long-established residential area of apartment complexes of varying age, with bungalows and villas on plotted lanes near Ramdev Nagar and Shyamal. Jodhpur, next to Shivranjani, is mostly apartments and builder floors. Vastrapur surrounds its lake, a long-time venue for music performances, with mid-rise blocks, newer towers and some bungalow lanes. Bodakdev, at the upmarket end, has tall gated towers alongside bungalow streets; Thaltej has spread outward from an old village and lake, and in Memnagar most families live in mid-rise societies of two- or three-bedroom flats.

Choosing a tutor here depends on which half of the zone you are in. The northern half sits on the Blue Line, which ends at Thaltej Gam and stops at Thaltej and Gurukul Road in Memnagar, so tutors from Navrangpura, the old city or the eastern suburbs can arrive by metro and finish by auto. The southern half has no station: in Satellite, Jodhpur and Vastrapur, tutors ride two-wheelers or use the BRTS and city buses on nearby corridors. Gated towers along the highway often ask each visitor for a phone number, and the highway and ring road junctions slow down in the office rush.

An NXTutors list for this zone opens with tutors who live along the corridor, then those who already travel to it, then the rest of Ahmedabad, then online tutors across India. Families preparing for competitive exams often add an online specialist to a home tutor. You receive two or three matched profiles with fees shown, choose one, and the first class is a free demo, at home or online. If the tutor later stops suiting your child, perhaps as the board year changes, moving to another tutor on the list costs nothing. Late-afternoon and weekend-morning lessons are the easiest to hold here.
faqs: Is there a metro station in Satellite or Vastrapur?

No. None of Satellite, Jodhpur or Vastrapur has a metro stop. For Vastrapur, the Blue Line stations in Memnagar and Thaltej are an auto ride away. Tutors heading to Satellite mostly ride a two-wheeler or come by car or auto, and some use BRTS or city bus routes that pass nearby.
Which station should a tutor use for a home in Thaltej?

Thaltej or Thaltej Gam, both on the Blue Line. Thaltej Gam has been the line's western end since December 2024, so a tutor boarding in Navrangpura, the old city or the eastern suburbs rides straight through. Plotted homes in Thaltej often have room to park at the door, which suits tutors who drive.
What housing do tutors find in Memnagar?

Mainly two- and three-bedroom apartments in mid-rise societies, with some independent houses, villas and builder floors. Many societies note visitors at the gate and have limited parking inside, so tutors on two-wheelers find it easiest. Gurukul Road station on the Blue Line is in Memnagar itself.
How are fees set for tutors in Bodakdev?

Each tutor sets their own fee and shows it before the demo, and nobody above your stated budget is suggested. Across NXTutors, most home-tuition sessions fall between ₹800 and ₹2,500 an hour; Classes 11–12, IB/IGCSE and JEE/NEET sit toward the upper end; specialists for IB HL or JEE Advanced can charge more.

intro: The south-western growth corridor covers Prahlad Nagar, Bopal, South Bopal and Shela. Prahlad Nagar sits right beside SG Highway, with premium gated flats, a few villas and penthouses, and a large cluster of offices and shopping centres; spare land is scarce, so new large projects are rare. Bopal grew quickly from a village into a big suburb of mid-priced apartments and gated societies, with villas in newer pockets, and Ghuma next door. South Bopal, often called SoBo, is almost entirely modern gated complexes and has a public park with sports courts. Shela, beyond it on the road towards Sanand, is filling with apartment towers, township-style projects, plots and villas.

This zone has no metro and no suburban railway, which shapes every decision about a tutor. The outer ring road is the main route past the Bopal crossroads, and one BRTS route reaches South Bopal, but a two-wheeler is how most tutors get here. Someone living across the Sabarmati might manage one demo, but a weekly journey that long rarely lasts. Large complexes in Shela and South Bopal may check a visitor at the main gate and again at the tower, and some issue passes, so the first visit takes longer. A common answer is to keep core subjects with a tutor from the neighbourhood and take a specialist subject online.

That is why NXTutors ranks tutors for this corridor by how close they live. Those inside Prahlad Nagar, Bopal, South Bopal or Shela come first, then tutors who already travel here, then the rest of Ahmedabad, then online tutors anywhere in India. Two or three matched profiles reach you with fees visible before booking, and the first lesson with your chosen tutor is a free demo. Late-afternoon slots avoid the office rush at the ring road junctions. If the tutor you pick stops suiting your child, you can switch to another one without paying anything extra.
faqs: Can a tutor reach South Bopal by bus?

Yes. BRTS Route 17 ends in South Bopal, so a tutor living along that corridor, towards Satellite, can come by bus. No metro serves the area; other tutors mostly ride along the outer ring road or SG Highway on two-wheelers and park at your society gate.
What should we expect at the gate in a Shela township?

Visitors are usually registered at the main gate and sometimes checked again at the tower, and some complexes issue a visitor pass. Share the tutor's name and phone number with security before the demo and allow extra time for the first visit. After that, weekly entry is normally quick.
How has Bopal changed as a place to live?

Quickly. Census figures show Bopal went from 18,553 residents in 2001 to 55,068 in 2011. In 2015 it merged with Ghuma to form a municipality, and both later came under the city corporation. Most homes today are mid-priced apartments and gated societies, with villas in newer pockets.
What do we need to tell NXTutors to get matched in Prahlad Nagar?

Your child's class, board and subjects, your locality and nearest landmark, whether you want lessons at home, online or both, the days and times that suit you, and your budget. You then get two or three tutors with fees shown and can book a free demo with one.

intro: Five localities in the north-west of the city, stretching up towards Gandhinagar, form this zone: Naranpura, Ghatlodia, Gota, Chandkheda and Sabarmati. Naranpura ranges from budget apartment blocks and mid-segment societies to large bungalows, with shopping streets around Vijay Char Rasta and Ankur Road. Ghatlodia is densely built and largely low-rise, with societies of two- and three-bedroom flats, independent houses and some villas. Gota grew after SG Highway was built and is mostly mid-range apartment societies. Chandkheda has housing board societies, company colonies, apartments and independent houses along the wide main road towards Gandhinagar and Tragad Road, and Sabarmati mixes apartments with older homes and railway colony areas.

The Red Line gives the eastern side of the zone a direct link to the rest of the city. It starts at Motera Stadium next to Chandkheda, runs through Sabarmati and AEC, and reaches Vijay Nagar in Naranpura before heading south to Paldi and Vasna. The Gandhinagar line also begins at Motera Stadium, so tutors living in the capital can come in by metro. Gota and Ghatlodia, on the western side, lack a station of their own, so a tutor either rides the Blue Line to Gurukul Road or Thaltej and takes an auto, catches the BRTS bus that ends in Gota, or simply drives a two-wheeler along SG Highway.

NXTutors starts a search in this zone with tutors who live here, then those who travel in, including from Gandhinagar along the metro, then others in Ahmedabad, then online tutors across India. Every family receives two or three matched tutors and can see each fee before anything is booked. The first class is a free demo, and there is no commitment until you have watched it. Families in the narrow internal roads of Naranpura often prefer a tutor on a two-wheeler. If you want to change tutor later, whether for a new class or a different subject, switching is free.
faqs: Can tutors from Gandhinagar reach Chandkheda by metro?

Yes. The Gandhinagar line starts at Motera Stadium, next to Chandkheda, and its final section into the capital opened in January 2026. A tutor living in Gandhinagar can ride to Motera Stadium and finish by auto, which widens the choice for families in Chandkheda and Sabarmati.
How do tutors get to Gota without a metro station?

The highway is the usual approach, by two-wheeler or car. BRTS Route 9 ends in Gota, giving tutors a bus option from other parts of the city. Apartment societies usually note visitors at the gate, and some confirm the visit with the family by phone.
Which metro station serves Naranpura?

Vijay Nagar on the Red Line, which runs north to Sabarmati and Motera Stadium and south to Old High Court, Paldi and Vasna. The Vijay Char Rasta area around it gets crowded in the evening, so a lesson that starts before the rush is easier to keep on time.
How much should we budget for a home tutor in Naranpura?

It depends on the class, subject and tutor. Across NXTutors, most home-tuition sessions fall between ₹800 and ₹2,500 an hour; Classes 11–12, IB/IGCSE and JEE/NEET sit toward the upper end; specialists for IB HL or JEE Advanced can charge more. No tutor above your budget is suggested.

intro: This zone covers the southern half of the east bank: Maninagar, Kankaria, Khokhra, Isanpur and Ghodasar. Maninagar is a busy mix of homes and markets, cut in two by the railway, where older houses line the shopping streets and newer apartment blocks cluster towards New Maninagar; the expressway to Vadodara also begins here. Kankaria wraps around a lake completed in 1451, the largest in the city, with old houses and flats on the approach streets. Khokhra's closed textile mills have given way to housing and campuses, and Isanpur, once a village, and Ghodasar consist mostly of modest low-rise apartment blocks.

Tutors have several ways in. Maninagar's railway station stands at the centre of the locality, and a footbridge takes passengers straight across to the BRTS buses. The underground Kankaria East stop on the Blue Line serves the lake side, Apparel Park and Amraiwadi are the metro stops for Khokhra, and Vatva station is another option for Isanpur. Low-rise blocks rarely have elaborate gate systems, which keeps a first visit simple. The two things to plan around are the evening crowds on Maninagar's market roads and the lakefront on Sundays, holidays and during the December carnival, when the streets near the water fill up.

On NXTutors, a family in this part of the city is shown tutors who live in the zone first, then those who already travel here by train, metro or bus, then others in Ahmedabad, and then online tutors across India for senior specialist subjects. You get two or three matched profiles, with each tutor's fee on view before the demo. The first lesson is free and can be at home or online. Market roads near Maninagar station crowd up in the evening, so earlier after-school slots are common. If the tutor stops working out, you can switch to someone else without any charge.
faqs: Which metro station is closest to Kankaria Lake?

Kankaria East on the Blue Line. It is underground, opened to passengers in March 2024, and sits between Kalupur to the west and Apparel Park to the east, so a tutor from the old city or the eastern suburbs can ride straight in. From Maninagar's railway station, an auto is the alternative.
Does Maninagar have a metro station?

Not inside the locality. What it has is a main-line railway station at its centre, joined by a footbridge to the BRTS bus station, so tutors arriving by train or bus can walk or hop on an auto. For metro riders, Kankaria East or, on the Khokhra side, Apparel Park are the nearest stops.
Is entry simple for tutors visiting Isanpur and Ghodasar?

Usually. Buildings here are mostly low-rise, so a tutor tends to go up to the flat without passing a formal security desk; in a bigger complex, ringing you from the entrance does the job. Maninagar and Vatva stations serve the area, and the roads towards Maninagar get busier in the evening.
What happens after the free demo in Maninagar?

You decide whether to continue with that tutor. If the demo did not suit your child, the next matched tutor can give a demo too. Fees are agreed as shown on each profile before booking, and changing tutor at any later point is free, so you are never locked in.

intro: The east of the city, where the old mill districts meet newer suburbs on the outer ring road, makes up this zone: Nikol, Naroda, Bapunagar, Vastral, Odhav and Amraiwadi. Bapunagar was built in the early 1960s as housing for mill workers and later became a diamond-cutting centre, with dense lanes of houses and low-rise blocks around a busy market. Amraiwadi, whose history goes back to a 15th-century garden, still has former mill chawls beside newer flats. Naroda has an old village core, Juna Naroda, and a newer residential side, Nava Naroda. Nikol and Vastral have grown fast with new apartment buildings, and Odhav mixes homes with its industrial estate.

Ahmedabad's metro began here, and it still divides the zone for a tutor. Vastral has three Blue Line stations, Vastral Gam, Nirant Cross Road and Vastral, and Rabari Colony, Amraiwadi and Apparel Park lie further west, so tutors from the old city or the west bank can reach the southern half by metro. Naroda has a railway station on the line to Udaipur but no metro, and Nikol and Odhav rely on road travel. Industrial shift changes around the Naroda and Odhav estates add to office-hour traffic, and in Bapunagar's narrow lanes a tutor on a two-wheeler manages far better than one in a car.

NXTutors builds a shortlist for an east Ahmedabad home by listing tutors who live in the zone first, then those who travel here on the Blue Line or by road, then the rest of the city, then online tutors across India for senior-class specialist subjects. You receive two or three matched tutors with their fees visible, pick one, and the first class is a free demo. Families in Nikol's gated societies should confirm visitor parking before that first visit. If the tutor later stops suiting your child, you can move to another tutor on the list at no cost.
faqs: Which parts of this zone are on the metro?

Vastral, with three Blue Line stations, and Amraiwadi, with Amraiwadi, Rabari Colony and Apparel Park stations close by. These sections opened in 2019, the first of Ahmedabad's metro. Naroda, Nikol and Odhav have no station, so tutors reach them by road, and Bapunagar homes are usually reached by two-wheeler or auto.
What is the difference between Juna Naroda and Nava Naroda for a tutor?

Juna Naroda is the old village core, where many homes open straight onto the lane, so a tutor walks up to the door. Nava Naroda is the newer side, with more apartment societies that use gate entry and usually have visitor parking inside. Naroda railway station sits in the industrial estate.
When is traffic heaviest around Odhav and Naroda?

At industrial shift changes as well as office hours, because both localities hold large industrial estates and the outer ring road passes close by. A mid-evening lesson, agreed in advance and kept fixed, usually avoids the worst of it. Online lessons help when a nearby specialist is not available.
Can we try online lessons first and move to home tuition later?

Yes. You can start with an online tutor, including for the free demo, and ask for a home tutor later, or combine both with the same tutor. Each tutor's fee is shown before you book, and switching tutor, or moving between home and online lessons, carries no charge at any stage.

intro: On the east bank, facing the western city over the Sabarmati, sit Shahibaug, Asarwa and Meghaninagar. Shahibaug is named after a garden palace from 1622 and remains one of the more comfortable addresses in Ahmedabad; its apartments are often large, with three or four bedrooms, and it borders Madhupura, Dudheshwar and Keshav Nagar. In Asarwa, big medical and teaching campuses take up much of the land, and families live in older houses or mid-income blocks in between. Meghaninagar, near Kalapi Nagar and the cantonment, is a more affordable pocket where rented and owned homes, both houses and flats, sit side by side.

Parents here should expect a tutor to come by road. The zone's own railway stop is Asarva, on the Udaipur line, and the metro runs underground on the far side of the old city, through Shahpur, Gheekanta and Kalupur. So the tutors who manage a weekly visit most easily tend to be those already living on the east bank and riding a two-wheeler along Riverfront Road, Airport Road or Camp Road. Asarwa's campus traffic lasts all day rather than just at peak, and Airport Road thickens once offices close. If the subject needs a teacher from the west bank, lessons on screen usually beat a long cross-river commute.

NXTutors therefore lists tutors from Shahibaug, Asarwa and Meghaninagar first, followed by tutors who have said they travel to these localities, then the rest of Ahmedabad, then online teachers from across India. For each request you are sent two or three profiles that fit the class, board and timetable, with the fee printed on each. The opening lesson is a free demo, held at home or online, and only afterwards do you decide. Many Shahibaug buildings phone the flat before letting a visitor up, so give the gate the tutor's name ahead of the demo. Swapping to another tutor later on is free.
faqs: What is the usual route for a tutor coming to Shahibaug?

Road, in most cases. Tutors ride along Riverfront Road or Airport Road by two-wheeler, auto or car, since no metro station lies inside the locality; the underground Blue Line stops are on the other side of the old city. Once offices close, Airport Road slows down, so late-afternoon lessons tend to start on time.
Which station serves Asarwa?

Asarva, on the Ahmedabad–Udaipur line, is the local railway stop and also the nearest one for Meghaninagar; an auto covers the remaining distance. Neither Asarwa nor Meghaninagar has a metro station. Because the medical campuses keep Asarwa's roads busy all day, agree a fixed evening time with the tutor rather than a floating afternoon one.
Is a first home visit in Meghaninagar straightforward?

Generally, yes. Families in houses simply open the door to the tutor, while apartment blocks may ask the tutor to sign a register at the gate, so tell the guard who is coming. Office-hour traffic on the roads to Asarwa and Naroda Road is the main hold-up, which is why many families pick a lesson later in the evening.
Will we know what a tutor charges before the demo?

Yes. Every profile on your shortlist of two or three carries the tutor's own fee, and you see it before the free demo is arranged. Across NXTutors, most home-tuition sessions fall between ₹800 and ₹2,500 an hour, with senior classes and entrance subjects toward the upper end of that range.
